label: Pre-encounter — an armed boor at a pageant

recentEvents.value: The court is withdrawing through the moon-gallery between dances; protocol has no entry for this.
An armed stranger declined the rites of welcome — all ninety seconds of them.

unresolvedConflicts.value: An armed stranger who understands every word and keeps rehearsing to be something the court has no protocol for.

temporaryObjective.value: Receive him as a protocol problem: the rites, the wine, the exit, in that order.
